def choose_move(observation):
    pos = observation.get("position", [0, 0])
    resource_pos = observation.get("resource", None)
    enemies = observation.get("enemies", [])
    territory_goal = observation.get("territory_goal", None)
    resource_scores = observation.get("resource_scores", [])
    enemy_scores = observation.get("enemy_scores", [])

    # Prioritize resource collection if resource available
    if resource_pos:
        dx = 1 if resource_pos[0] > pos[0] else -1 if resource_pos[0] < pos[0] else 0
        dy = 1 if resource_pos[1] > pos[1] else -1 if resource_pos[1] < pos[1] else 0
        return [dx, dy]

    # Defensive: avoid enemies if present
    if enemies:
        # Determine nearest enemy
        nearest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: (e[0] - pos[0])**2 + (e[1] - pos[1])**2)
        # If enemy is very close, attempt to move away
        dist_sq = (nearest_enemy[0] - pos[0])**2 + (nearest_enemy[1] - pos[1])**2
        if dist_sq <= 2:
            dx = -1 if nearest_enemy[0] >= pos[0] else 1 if nearest_enemy[0] < pos[0] else 0
            dy = -1 if nearest_enemy[1] >= pos[1] else 1 if nearest_enemy[1] < pos[1] else 0
            # Try to move away; if blocked, stay put
            return [dx, dy]

    # Pursue territory goal if no immediate threats
    if territory_goal:
        dx = 1 if territory_goal[0] > pos[0] else -1 if territory_goal[0] < pos[0] else 0
        dy = 1 if territory_goal[1] > pos[1] else -1 if territory_goal[1] < pos[1] else 0
        return [dx, dy]

    # Collect highest resource score if available
    if resource_scores:
        max_idx = resource_scores.index(max(resource_scores))
        target_pos = observation.get("resource_positions", [])[max_idx]
        dx = 1 if target_pos[0] > pos[0] else -1 if target_pos[0] < pos[0] else 0
        dy = 1 if target_pos[1] > pos[1] else -1 if target_pos[1] < pos[1] else 0
        return [dx, dy]

    # Defensive: avoid enemies based on scores as well
    if enemy_scores:
        # Identify enemies with high threat (lowest score)
        min_score = min(enemy_scores)
        min_idx = enemy_scores.index(min_score)
        threat_enemy = observation.get("enemy_positions", [])[min_idx]
        dist_sq = (threat_enemy[0] - pos[0])**2 + (threat_enemy[1] - pos[1])**2
        if dist_sq <= 2:
            dx = -1 if threat_enemy[0] >= pos[0] else 1 if threat_enemy[0] < pos[0] else 0
            dy = -1 if threat_enemy[1] >= pos[1] else 1 if threat_enemy[1] < pos[1] else 0
            return [dx, dy]

    # Default: stay still
    return [0, 0]
